text: Section 7: read stage A1's three sentences from notes-A1.md (lines 41-43), the first time since A1. Close of C3c and of stage C3. The four universal problems put to the structure as it stood, nothing revised (mapping-C3.jsonl, 28 lines; F-016): information 4 themes 555 rooms, reward 2 themes 543 (credit after the work; offered before it in 9), allocation 2 themes 394 (self-selection 345; assignment 46), division 1 theme 237 (by artifact; among teams 5); two themes by construction (Mobilization, Completion ritual), and the frame would cut through Completion ritual; remainder 19 (7 between rooms, 8 making the boundary and the goal, machine hands, repair, 2 after the clock). Verdict: a weak form supported, silent on necessity, the frame cannot lose on reward, leaning against sufficiency for telling forms apart.
